message: OAuth configuration for endpoint getToken must define a dot-delimited 'access-token' property starting with $response (e.g. $response.access_token).
OAuth configuration for endpoint getToken must define a dot-delimited 'client-id' property starting with $request (e.g. $request.client_id).
OAuth configuration for endpoint getToken must define a dot-delimited 'expires-in' property starting with $response (e.g. $response.expires_in).
